entries.snippet: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

entries.title: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
entries.snippet: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago. The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

entries.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
entries.snippet: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

entries.snippet: The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

entries.title: Civil rights advocates plan to send thousands of observers to midterm polling places
entries.snippet: For many election cycles, civil rights groups and political parties have fanned out to monitor polling places, but the charged midterm environment has many organizations stepping up efforts this year.

entries.title: 'They're stealing from the poor': A major source of SNAP fraud robs recipients of millions
entries.snippet: Organized criminal rings target SNAP recipients because of the government program's outdated security features. But upgrading the tech costs money and states' SNAP budgets are getting squeezed.

entries.title: In Kansas, a newly competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
entries.snippet: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Rep. Begich faces challenger Hill in a debate for Alaska's at-large House seat

entries.title: Attorney for banned outlets on legal fight over White House press access
entries.snippet: A federal judge has once again ordered the White House to restore access for three news organizations President Trump banned last month over their coverage of his administration. The judge ordered full access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their legal challenge moves forward.

entries.snippet: This year's increase is 3.6%, based on inflation data, amounting to a little more than $900 next year.

entries.snippet: The latest polling for the upcoming midterms shows a tilt in Democrats' favor. For an inside view of the final weeks of the campaign, Geoff Bennett spoke with Democratic strategist Mo Elleithee and Republican strategist Doug Heye.

entries.title: How immigration policies shaped America and evolved throughout its history
entries.snippet: The Trump administration's crackdown on immigration may be novel in its tools, methods and scope, but it belongs to a long tradition in this nation's past. Judy Woodruff reports for her series, Crossroads: America at 250.

entries.title: South Americans pray for Pope Leo's recovery as uncertainty hangs over his visit

entries.title: Lawyers for Federal Reserve's Lisa Cook say White House hearing set up by Trump is 'biased'
entries.snippet: Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook's lawyers say that a committee set up by the White House last week to investigate an accusation against her is "demonstrably biased," though they did not close the door on the possibility that she would appear before the panel.

entries.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Saudi oil company Aramco's headquarters, officials say
entries.snippet: Iran-backed Houthi rebels hit the headquarters of the Saudi state-owned oil company Aramco in an overnight strike, two regional officials said Wednesday, damaging the offices of the firm's chief executive and other top officials.

entries.title: WATCH: Nebraska voters hear from Harding, Powell in midterm House debate
entries.snippet: Voters in Nebraska will hear from the two major party candidates seeking to replace retiring Rep. Don Bacon during a debate Wednesday.

entries.title: A gang rape allegation at Cornell highlights how Title IX guides campus sex assault cases
entries.snippet: Cornell University's handling of an alleged fraternity house gang rape is raising questions about how a decades-old federal civil rights law shapes colleges' treatment of campus sexual assault.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Candidates in race to replace Iowa Rep. Feenstra meet for debate
entries.snippet: Republican candidate Chris McGowan and Democratic candidate Dave Dawson will meet face-to-face for a debate Wednesday as they seek the U.S. House seat in Iowa's 4th Congressional District.

entries.title: Cornell president admits he never followed up on gang rape allegation ahead of no-confidence debate
entries.snippet: Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff knew in 2024 that a student had reported being gang raped at a fraternity house, but never followed up to learn what had happened to her or whether any of the accused students had been punished.

entries.title: How proposed cuts to this major national health survey could disadvantage Americans with disabilities
entries.snippet: As many as a quarter of wheelchair users and more than a third of people who are blind or deaf could be miscategorized as not disabled because of the shorter survey, according to some advocates and researchers.

entries.title: Justice Department threatens California with legal action over claim of noncitizens on voter rolls
entries.snippet: The U.S. Department of Justice has threatened California with possible legal action over what it says are noncitizens believed to have received mail ballots for next month's midterm elections.

entries.title: ICE officer appeared to intentionally hit a man with a vehicle in Houston, Texas prosecutor says
entries.snippet: The encounter has set off new criticism over immigration enforcement in Houston, where local prosecutors are also investigating a July fatal shooting by a federal immigration officer.

entries.title: IMF chief urges wealthy nations to rein in debt to ease global economic pressure
entries.snippet: The U.S. and other wealthy nations need to urgently tackle mounting global debt levels that are weighing most heavily on low-income countries and straining the global financial system, the head of the International Monetary Fund said Wednesday.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ukraine says Musk's SpaceX limits Kyiv's Starlink access
entries.snippet: Ukraine accused SpaceX of restricting use of its Starlink system, impacting Kyiv's ability to control its drones as Russian attacks continue unabated. President Zelenskyy has asked Elon Musk to "switch" it back on.

entries.title: Nord Stream trial opens in Germany, defense seeks dismissal
entries.snippet: Serhii Kuznietsov is accused of attacking civilian infrastructure in the 2022 sabotage of the Russian gas pipeline to Germany. His lawyers called Nord Stream a military target, and said their client is sworn to secrecy.

entries.title: How Trump's diesel deal with Russia will impact the United States and Ukraine
entries.snippet: US President Trump's diesel deal with Russia has alarmed Ukraine and its allies. What is he hoping to achieve at home, and what does the deal mean for Kyiv and Moscow?

entries.title: Japanese journalist arrest in Russia's Far East draws rebuke from Tokyo in latest diplomatic spat with Moscow
entries.snippet: A journalist for a Japanese newspaper was arrested on suspicion of spying in Russia's Far East. A geopolitical rivalry over disputed islands in the region has recently caused tension.

entries.title: Turkey: Government raids, takes over top news channel
entries.snippet: Turkish authorities have raided the Istanbul offices of Halk TV, halting broadcasts, appointing a trustee and opening an investigation. It is the latest chapter of a decadeslong media capture by President Erdogan.

entries.title: India urges Russia, Ukraine to protect Black Sea shipping
entries.snippet: New Delhi wants Moscow and Kyiv to ensure safe commercial shipping in the Black Sea amid attacks that put Indian seafarers at risk.

entries.title: Germany's far-right AfD forges a pro-Russia alliance with the BSW
entries.snippet: In Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD and BSW are joining forces to push for negotiations with Moscow. What is driving this rapprochement?

entries.title: Albania: Fire at Education Ministry as students protest
entries.snippet: Riot police deployed in the Albanian capital Tirana on the second day of student protests. The sudden outbreak seemed at least somewhat reminiscent of the widespread demos in France courting international attention.

entries.title: Climate change and drone attacks exacerbate the humanitarian crisis in war-torn Sudan
entries.snippet: Aid groups warn of an imminent collapse of the health system as fighting continues to displace civilians amid the planting season. The UN has extended an arms embargo, but only for Darfur.

entries.title: Indonesian VIP prison scandal exposes inequality across Southeast Asia
entries.snippet: Luxury accommodation uncovered at an Indonesian prison has reignited concerns about preferential treatment for wealthy convicts across Southeast Asia.

entries.title: Trump's diesel deal with Russia is unlikely to significantly lower global fuel prices despite expectations of rapid relief
entries.snippet: As the world's largest diesel exporter, the US benefits from high prices. At home, however, consumers are feeling the strain of rising living costs. Why Donald Trump's deal with Russia is unlikely to change that.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz attacks extremes for fueling division
entries.snippet: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz accuses the far-right AfD and the socialist Left Party of deliberately fueling division and seeking political advantage from chaos. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Houthis launch fresh wave of missiles across Saudi Arabia
entries.snippet: Both the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition carried out strikes targeting energy infrastructure. Four people were injured as a result of debris of intercepted missiles in Riyadh. DW has the latest.

entries.title: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
entries.snippet: Home to more than 700 million gamers, China is the world's largest gaming market — but it's also one of the most tightly regulated. The effects reach far beyond China, impacting players around the world.

entries.title: Nord Stream: Germany puts suspected Ukrainian pipeline saboteur on trial
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian citizen faces court in Hamburg, accused of attacking the Nord Stream gas pipelines in 2022. It raises questions about Kyiv's possible role in the explosions. German support for Ukraine is also under scrutiny.

entries.title: Trump's US Super Intelligence Force and AI czar Jay Clayton
entries.snippet: Trump announced a new Super Intelligence task force with the White House AI czar Jay Clayton in charge of a group responsible for making sure the US leads international competition in artificial intelligence development.

entries.title: Trump announces plans for major oil, gas and mineral exploration in Greenland
entries.snippet: The US president has claimed Greenland holds vast and easily accessible oil reserves without providing evidence or details. His announcement follows a deal expanding the US military presence on the Arctic island.

entries.title: Fact check: Misleading graph about alleged Russian bot activity
entries.snippet: Did attacks on Russian data centers reduce bot activity around Germany's AfD? A viral graph claims they did. But it contains significant inconsistencies and provides no evidence to support the claim.

entries.title: Do non-German nationals commit more crimes than Germans?
entries.snippet: People without German passports appear more frequently in German police crime statistics than German nationals. A new study explains why.
